text.en:
8th. MAY, 2003 No. S 20

BRUNEI NATIONAL PETROLEUM COMPANY

SENDIRIAN BERHAD ORDER, 2002 (S 6/2002) Notice of amendment of the granting of mineral rights by His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council pursuant to section 3(1) It is hereby notified that His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council has, pursuant to subsection Ill of section 3, on the 14th. day of April, 2003 amended the designated area referred to as Block J - {a} by inserting immediately after the coordinates referred to as J05, the following coordinates - ";and {b) by inserting immediately after the coordinates referred to as JK08, the following coordinates JK09 432,000.000 645,ooo.ooo 1 , Dated this 14th. day of April, 2003.

PEHIN ORANG KAYA PEKERMA JAYA

DATO PADUKA HAJIJUDIN BIN HAJI ASAR Clerk to the Council of Ministers, Brunei Darussalam.
